content: Create a 18-second cinematic 3D animated workplace comedy video based on the provided storyboard. Keep Emma, the boss, coworkers, office, outfits, and character appearances consistent throughout. Emma arrives late to a corporate meeting, starts presenting Q3 results, suddenly gets a sneeze attack, tries drinking water but fails, then sneezes loudly causing papers to fly everywhere. Everyone laughs while Emma looks embarrassed. Finally, the boss points toward the door and says, “Get out.” Emma sadly walks out carrying the papers.
